newsitem.title: USA: Tellabs '96 boosted by cross-connect sales.
newsitem.headline: Tellabs '96 boosted by cross-connect sales.

text.p: Telecommunications equipment manufacturer Tellabs Inc, reporting higher 1996 sales, said sales of its TITAN 3300 digital cross-connect systems grew 69 percent, and Martis DXX system sales rose 55 percent from 1995 levels.
It said sales of digital echo cancellers were up slightly, despite the long-anticipated loss of the company's largest echo customer early in the year.

"As we have discussed throughout the year, sales of our CABLESPAN cable telephony product were well below our initial expectations for 1996," noted president Michael Birck in a statement. "We are cautiously optimistic about future CABLESPAN activity, particularly outside the United States."
